title: Construction of Gabion wall for protection of LH tower and premises at Kovilthottam Lighthouse.
summary: Two-cover e-tender for construction of a gabion wall to protect the lighthouse tower and premises at Kovilthottam Lighthouse, Kollam District, Kerala.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Kovilthottam Lighthouse, Kovilthottam, District: Kollam, Kerala - 691583
sites.work: Construction of gabion wall for protection of LH tower and premises

scope.item: Construction of Gabion wall for protection of LH tower and premises

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by 18.12.2024 15:00.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80% (only fully completed works with completion certificate)
Similar work: construction of sea protection work by groins/gabion wall/tetrapod etc.
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Bidders whose near relatives are accountants or officers of Junior Engineer grade or higher in DGLL not permitted
notes: Document is Section I (NIT) only; no BOQ. NIT dated 25.11.2024; bid download/submission 27.11.2024 10:00 to 19.12.2024 15:00; bid query last date 03.12.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 20.12.2024 15:00.
